step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture illustrates a rendering and content management platform built by Arc Publishing at The Washington Post. Public users send web requests to an origin ECS cluster, which routes requests to S3 buckets for static resources and pre-rendered content, or triggers a Lambda function for dynamic rendering. The Lambda function interacts with DynamoDB for templates/configuration, writes pre-rendered content to S3, and connects to a second ECS proxy cluster to fetch content from ElastiCache or external/internal CMS APIs. Developers and newsroom users interact with Lambda and DynamoDB directly for publishing page templates and deploying code.
